fields.name: THE RULES
fields.value: $1,000 FAAB per season, $0 bids allowed, $1 increments, hidden bids, daily processing at about 11:00 AM ET (Article X). FAAB does not roll over.

fields.name: CONSOLATION BONUS
fields.value: The consolation-bracket champion gets a $50 FAAB bonus next season. Current-season FAAB can be traded (Article XI).

fields.name: OFFICIAL CLAIMS
fields.value: Actual claims stay in Fantrax. Discord never submits or changes a claim.
